MASTER CALENDAR JURY
Off Calendar Feb-24-2005 Continued To Feb-28-05 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 206

COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Feb-28-2005 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on as re-assigned by the Master Calendar Dept. 206 for Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Daniel Bornstein, Esq. for Plaintiff: Lou Cox, Inc. dba The Union Group.
No appearance by the Defendants: Marco Bimbo and Victoria Bimbo.
Plaintiff's witness: Lou Cox, was sworn and direct examined.
Exh. 1 - Rental agreement----------ID/EVID.
Exh. 2 - Three-day Notice----------ID/EVID.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defendants: Marco Bimbo and Victoria Bimbo as follows:
Restitution and possession of the premises located at 542 25th Ave., #1, San Francisco.
Lease agreement is forfeited.
Rent and Per Diem Damages of $7,250.00
No Attorney's Fees.
Costs $248.30 for a total of $7,498.30
Counsel stipulated for the return of the Exhibits in open court.
Judgment signed in open court.

MASTER CALENDAR COURT
Off Calendar Feb-28-2005 Assigned To Trial Court
